title: Midea UZ21 — Forced defrost (test mode 3)
description: From test mode, select forced defrost — heater on, compressor/fan off.

steps.title: Forced defrost in test mode
steps.body: Enter test mode (LOCK + − 3 s). Press Vacation button — display shows 3. Heater runs until defrost sensor reaches 12°C/7°C or 60 min max. Power-cycle after field use.
